title: Sports Betting Just Passed The Lottery
source: US legal sports betting handle (total amount wagered) from the American Gaming Association, as compiled by Legal Sports Report/Covers: $13.0B (2019), $21.5B (2020), $57.75B (2021), $93.2B (2022), $119.84B (2023), $149.6B (2024). US lottery ticket sales (traditional draw and instant games) from La Fleur's Magazine/NASPL fiscal-year reports: $80.8B (2019), $80.9B (2020), $94.9B (2021), $108.0B (2022), $113.34B (2023), $113.3B (2024). Sports betting handle overtook lottery sales for the first time in 2023, three years after most states began legalizing mobile sportsbooks.
